meta.calibration_and_thresholds: CAL splits weighted by dataset share (same as training)

private_suffix.1: hosted as a subdomain of a free hosting platform
private_suffix.0: not on a free-subdomain hosting platform

is_homepage.1: bare landing page with no path

brand_in_sub.1: well-known brand name in the subdomain (impersonation pattern)

brand_in_path.1: well-known brand name in the path

brand_typo.1: look-alike spelling of a well-known brand

brand_in_sld_not_equal.1: brand name embedded in an unrelated domain

brand_is_sld.1: domain is a well-known brand's own domain
brand_is_sld.0: not a major brand's own domain

host_is_ip.1: raw IP address instead of a domain name

shortener.1: URL shortener hides the real destination
